artifact: PHASE 3 / 6.01 DEPENDENCY-DELIVERY REMEDIATION §22/§23/§24 - the MISSING_CONTEXT claim is now checkable, the tool budget is now auditable, and the operative-state flag is classified

section22_contract.before: SHARD_MISSING_CONTEXT was an unclassified self-report: nothing checked the model's claim against the evidence package it was handed
section22_contract.after: every dependency a shard reports as missing is classified against its own certificate and delivered context
classes: PLANNER_DELIVERY_GAP (required, deliverable, NOT delivered - impossible on a certified shard; an alarm, not a diagnosis)
PARTIAL_DELIVERY (delivered as a disclosed bounded excerpt; the tool route is the right answer)
OPTIONAL_CONTEXT_MISS (interpretive; the tool budget is the designed route - the ONLY class for which 'the model should have called a tool' is an acceptable answer)
section22_contract.wiredInto: shard-executor.ts sets missingContextAudit on every shard result; compile.ts carries it, and each shard's dependencyCertificate, into the durable run record

section23_toolTelemetry.evidenceLimitationThisCloses: the durable shard record persists the terminal composition and telemetry but NOT the tool-call log, so the exact number of live tool calls, refusals and remaining call slots cannot be read from the frozen evidence. Turn counts and their input-token growth are recoverable from the run log and are reported as the strongest available proxy. §23 adds the telemetry that removes this limitation.
section23_toolTelemetry.wiredInto: shard-executor.ts summariseToolUsage(compile.toolCallLog) -> ShardExecutionResult.toolUsage -> SemanticShardExecutionSummary.toolUsage in the durable run record
whatItAnswersNextTime: did the model ever request this dependency?
was the request refused, and why?
how many call slots and source chars were left when the shard stopped?
section23_toolTelemetry.note: telemetry is diagnosis, not remediation: it makes the next A/B/C/D/E classification auditable instead of NOT_AUDITABLE. It does not itself deliver anything.

frozenObservation.harnessSupplied: computeOperativeContractState over the package's real (empty) effect set - OPERATIVE_STATE_RESOLVED, 0 provisions
frozenObservation.trace: the single flagged shard (shard:f266a61ab75f65592b9d) ended SHARD_COMPLETE and contains no CONFLICTED rule; its flag comes from bounded-composition.ts hasStaleReferencedDefinition(), which returns true because that shard emitted IR definitions for 'incur' and 'incurrence' - ordinary verb forms that are NOT defined terms in the instrument - so resolveOperativeDefinitionEvidence cannot confirm them as current operative truth.
frozenObservation.previousRunCause: OPERATIVE_STATE_WIRING_WRONG - the harness passed operativeState: null, so every section-reading tool returned evidenceUnresolved=true. That cause is gone: the harness now supplies the deterministic package fact and five of six shards carry no operative-state flag.

That is an OUTPUT condition of a shard that ended SHARD_COMPLETE, not a missing input: no required dependency of that shard is undelivered.
